name: qa-bdd
description: Behavior-driven development with Cucumber, Behave and Reqnroll: Gherkin from user stories and acceptance criteria, step libraries, and living docs. Converts stories, acceptance-criteria lists, manual steps or raw specs into Gherkin, keeps step definitions DRY, and covers SpecFlow-to-Reqnroll migration. Agents (bdd-scenario-author, gherkin-style-reviewer) write scenarios with step stubs and flag imperative steps and technical leakage.
